full_judgment:
Md. Joynul Abedin, J : This Death Reference under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure having arisen out of the capital sentence awarded to the condemned prisoner Md Ershad Ali Sikder under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code in Sessions Case No. 81 of 1999 together with Criminal Appeal Nos. 1211 of 2000, 1281 of 2000 preferred by the condemned prisoner Ershad Ali Sikder and accused appellants Farooq alias Jamai Farooq, Idris Ali, Moti, Md Alam alias Franch Alam and Jalil Mollah respectively and Jail Appeal No. 1296 of 2000 preferred by the condemned prisoner Ershad Ali Sikder are heard together and disposed of by this single judgment. Except the condemned prisoner Ershad Ali Sikder the accused appellants in the aforesaid Criminal Appeal No. 1281 of 2000 were convicted under sections 302/34 and also under section 144 of the Penal Code. But since the aforesaid 6 accused appellants were sentenced under sections 302/34 they were not separately sentenced under section 144 of the Penal Code. 

 4. On receipt of the case record the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Third Court, Khulna framed charge against the aforesaid 7 accused persons under sections 302, 34 and 144 of the Penal Code on 13-3-2000 and explained the contents thereof to them when the accused persons pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. The prosecution in all examined 25 witnesses in support of the prosecution case and after the close of the prosecution evidence all the aforesaid accused except accused Mokhtar were examined under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure when they again pleaded their innocence and declined to adduce any evidence. 

 6. The prosecution in all examined 25 witnesses to prove the offence charged. The learned Additional Sessions Judge on consideration of the oral evidence of these witnesses, injury certificate issued by PW 11, Dr Khan Omar Farooq, post mortem report issued by PW 13 Dr Tojendra Chandra Das and the statements made by the, accused persons during their examination under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure convicted accused Ershad Ali Sikder under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code and sentenced him to death by hanging and at the same time convicted the remaining 6 accused persons also under sections 302/34 and section 144 of the Penal Code and sentenced them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and in view of this sentence no separate sentence was passed against them under section 144 of the Penal Code. 

 37. But from the evidence on record we find that the appellant’s were members of the unlawful assembly armed with deadly weapons and they came with Ershad Ali Sikder to the place of occurrence with the said weapons in their hands. This evidence is sufficient to hold them liable for the offence under section 144 of the Penal Code and for which maximum sentence is two years which they, in the meantime served out.
